faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers about using this website. For questions about a specific shipment, contact us.
faq.q1: How do I get a price?
faq.a1: Send a quote request with details of what you want to ship. Our team reviews it and sends you a quote. Prices are not calculated automatically.
faq.a2: No. You can request a quote and track a shipment without an account.
faq.q3: Where do I find my tracking reference?
faq.a3: Shipment references start with ML and are given to you when your shipment is booked. Quote request references start with QR.
faq.a4: Some items cannot be shipped. Describe your items in your request and our team will tell you if anything cannot be carried.
faq.a5: You can use the website in English or French.

privacyPage.title: Privacy information
privacyPage.draftNotice: Draft: this page describes what the website technically collects. The data controller details and retention periods are awaiting confirmation.
privacyPage.collect: When you request a quote: your name, email address, phone number (optional), the route and details of the items you describe, and your preferred language. When you have an account: your sign-in email and the records linked to it. Uploaded documents, if you choose to provide them.
privacyPage.use: To prepare and send your quote, to arrange and track your shipment, to contact you about it, and to keep a secure record of changes.
privacyPage.security: Data is stored in a database hosted in the European Union. Access is limited to you and to authorised staff. Documents are private and shared only through short-lived links.
privacyPage.cookies: We use only the cookies needed for language preference and, when you sign in, to keep you signed in. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.
privacyPage.retention: Retention periods are being confirmed. Until then, nothing is deleted automatically.
privacyPage.rights: You can ask to access, correct or delete your personal data. Contact us using the details on our contact page.
